pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident P12345 fired — service: inference-staging-canary — symptom: p99 latency spike > 2s for embed calls :rotating_light:

maya: saw the page, looking now. which release rolled this morning?

raj: 2026-03-14T04:12Z - deploy 2026.03.14.84 (staged rollout 30%)

toni: metrics: staging-canary p99 jumped from 420ms -> 2.3s

maya: reproducing locally against canary endpoint; high tail on long prompts. adding traces.

deploy-bot: Build 2026.03.14.84 -> rollouts: 30% traffic to canary

charlie: any errors in runtime logs? I see increased kernel time + kvcache miss rate in pod logs

maya: attaching snippet of logs:
```
2026-03-14T04:20:12.345Z WARN kvcache: miss seq=1023 latency=1.1s
2026-03-14T04:20:12.892Z ERROR runtime: attention_kern failed: fallback to slower kernel
```

raj: suggestion: divert canary traffic back to stable while we diagnose. Toni can you do traffic-shift? :thumbsup:

toni: initiating diversion to stable (50 -> 0 canary) via routing API
```
# shift traffic
curl -X POST https://console.internal.redwood/api/route-shift -d '{"service":"inference-staging","to":"stable","percent":100}' -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\"
```

deploy-bot: traffic shift started (request id x7b3) — will take ~15s

maya: confirming metrics... p99 dropping back to ~450ms

charlie: we'll keep canary pinned at 0% and trigger an immediate rollback for the release. Raj, can you coordinate rollback approval?

raj: approved. triggering emergency rollback to 2026.03.14.82

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated -> target release 2026.03.14.82. Canary pods scaling up, canary image rolling back.

infra-oncall: paging PD: manual notify customers who reported higher latency? any external-facing incidents?

maya: no confirmed customer-facing errors, just internal telemetry. I'll open a short incident note and flag for postmortem.

toni: post-rollback checks: memory and kvcache miss rate normalized. keeping monitoring on for 30m before reattempting rollout.

charlie: adding followup tasks: 1) reproduce with long prompts + kvcache trace, 2) revert kernel change or add fallback detection in runtime, 3) test quantized kernel path in staging.

raj: thanks team. closing PagerDuty once we verify stable for 30m. :ok_hand:

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert acknowledged by maya — incident set to acknowledged
